title: Specific LM Providers
summary: This module provides concrete implementations for managing and interacting with specific language model providers, including Databricks, local SGLang servers, and OpenAI, for tasks like finetuning and deployment.

nodes.label: Manage Databricks Models
nodes.title: DatabricksProvider
nodes.description: Handles finetuning, deployment, and data upload for models hosted on Databricks, interacting with Databricks APIs for model serving and training.

nodes.label: Track Databricks Finetuning Job
nodes.title: TrainingJobDatabricks
nodes.description: Represents and monitors the status of a finetuning job specifically on the Databricks platform, querying its progress and state.

nodes.label: Manage Local SGLang Models
nodes.title: LocalProvider
nodes.description: Provides functionality to launch, manage, and finetune local language models using SGLang servers, including process control and data preparation.

nodes.label: Tokenize Data for SFT
nodes.title: tokenize_function
nodes.description: A helper function used to tokenize training examples, preparing them for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of local language models.

nodes.label: Track OpenAI Finetuning Job
nodes.title: TrainingJobOpenAI
nodes.description: Manages and tracks the lifecycle of finetuning jobs on the OpenAI platform, including capabilities for cancellation and status checks.

nodes.label: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.title: BaseLM
nodes.description: The foundational interface for all language models in DSPy, defining common methods and properties that providers must implement.

nodes.label: Base Training Job Interface
nodes.title: TrainingJob
nodes.description: An abstract base class for managing and tracking the status of finetuning jobs across different language model providers.

nodes.label: Databricks Platform API
nodes.title: Databricks API
nodes.description: External API for interacting with Databricks services, including model serving endpoint management, finetuning, and data storage.

nodes.label: Local SGLang Inference Server
nodes.title: SGLang Server
nodes.description: A local server powered by SGLang, used for efficient inference and serving of local language models.

nodes.label: OpenAI Platform API
nodes.title: OpenAI API
nodes.description: External API for interacting with OpenAI services, specifically for managing finetuning jobs and associated files.

groups.label: Surface Providers
groups.title: LM Provider Interfaces
groups.description: These components serve as the primary interfaces for interacting with different language model platforms.

groups.label: Data Preparation
groups.title: Data Processing Helpers
groups.description: Components involved in preparing data for finetuning processes.

groups.label: Training Job Management
groups.title: Finetuning Job Trackers
groups.description: These components manage and track the status of finetuning jobs on specific platforms.
